statement: Six disjoint whole-case selector partitions retain every assertion, ci/tools labels and 30-second deadlines. Selection, CI replay and publication, CMake fixtures, process-tree checks, base-ref subprocesses and locale subprocesses have separate entries in both engine and compiler-free CTest projects. Direct invocation and unittest discovery retain the complete suite. Roster and CLI regressions reject unknown, duplicate, missing and invalid selections and pin exact coverage. Windows retains four-slot reservations; hosted Windows deadline qualification remains pending. Publication failure still overrides pending replay exceptions and cancellation after cache namespace restoration, without returning from finally.
